meta.name: geopandas
meta.description: Python library for working with geospatial vector data including shapefiles, GeoJSON, and GeoPackage files. Use when working with geographic data for spatial analysis, geometric operations, coordinate transformations, spatial joins, overlay operations, choropleth mapping, or any task involving reading/writing/analyzing vector geographic data. Supports PostGIS databases, interactive maps, and integration with matplotlib/folium/cartopy. Use for tasks like buffer analysis, spatial joins between datasets, dissolving boundaries, clipping data, calculating areas/distances, reprojecting coordinate systems, creating maps, or converting between spatial file formats.

copy.tagline: 处理地理空间矢量数据，进行空间分析与制图
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要处理 shapefile、GeoJSON 等地理数据并做空间分析
copy.tagline_en: Process geospatial vector data for spatial analysis and mapping
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to work with shapefiles, GeoJSON, or other vector geographic data for spatial analysis

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能用 Python 的 GeoPandas 库处理地理空间数据，比如读取 shapefile、GeoJSON 等文件，进行坐标转换、面积计算、空间连接、地图绘制等操作。
howto.when: 当你要求处理地理数据（如地图、位置信息），或需要做空间分析（如缓冲区、叠加、合并）时触发。

say.text: 帮我读取这个 GeoJSON 文件，并计算每个区域的面积。
say.note: Claude 会用 GeoPandas 读取文件并计算面积。

say.text: 将这两个 shapefile 进行空间连接，找出落在每个多边形内的点。
say.note: Claude 会执行空间连接操作。

say.text: 把这个数据投影到 EPSG:3857，然后画一个人口分布图。
say.note: Claude 会进行坐标转换并绘制地图。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can use the GeoPandas Python library to handle geospatial vector data: read/write shapefiles, GeoJSON, GeoPackage; perform coordinate transformations, area/distance calculations, spatial joins, overlays, and create maps.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to work with geographic data (e.g., maps, locations) or perform spatial analysis tasks like buffering, overlaying, or joining spatial datasets.

say_en.text: Read this GeoJSON file and calculate the area of each region.
say_en.note: Claude will use GeoPandas to read and compute areas.

say_en.text: Spatially join these two shapefiles to find points inside each polygon.
say_en.note: Claude will perform a spatial join.

say_en.text: Reproject this data to EPSG:3857 and plot a population map.
say_en.note: Claude will transform CRS and create a map.
